title: Mexican Corn Sopes
description: A traditional Mexican dish featuring crispy sopes topped with a flavorful mixture of grilled corn, onions, and oozy cheese.

ingredients.name: Oozy Cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Asadero work well

instructions: Grill the corn over medium heat until slightly charred.
Cut the corn off the cob and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until translucent.
Stir in the refried beans (if using) and cook for an additional minute.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the sopes by spreading a spoonful of the bean mixture onto each tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the grilled corn.
Top each sope with a spoonful of oozy cheese and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Bake the sopes in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
